digest.component_or_area: code quality gate - complexity baseline wrapper and maintenance
propositions: Function complexity must be tracked against a committed baseline to allow new/increased debt detection while accepting legacy debt at known ceilings

The wrapper must distinguish Ruff return code 0/1 (valid diagnostic-bearing JSON) from 2+ (scanner failure) and normalize Python AST qualified symbols (dot-joined class/function ancestry) as immutable baseline keys

Baseline ceilings must be integers > 15 per function; --check mode exits 0 only when all current findings are at or below ceilings with no new/increased debt; --update-stale mode atomically lowers/removes stale entries but refuses to write for new/increased debt or errors
The complexity gate must cover only production code under src/rebar (not tests) with threshold 15; make lint integrates the wrapper check alongside existing Ruff/format checks over src and tests

The baseline JSON schema requires schema_version 1, repository-relative POSIX paths, sorted ceiling keys, and rejects unknown fields, duplicates, unsorted keys, and invalid UTF-8; the live census on origin/main must equal baseline entry count
